# Xencorp Solutions Website Map for LLMs

This website describes Xencorp Solutions, a premium global enterprise software consulting and systems engineering firm. We merge high-level technology consulting with proprietary platform accelerators.

## Core Identity

- **Name**: Xencorp Solutions
- **Location**: Lahore, Pakistan (Strategic Engineering Center)
- **Focus**: Custom Software, ERP, GRC, FinTech, and AI Automations.
- **Differentiators**: 100% IP ownership, Senior Architects on all projects, Compliance-ready codebases (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, DORA).

## Site Architecture

All endpoints serve pre-rendered Next.js content:

- `/` (Home): Who is Xencorp, business metrics, and core differentiators.
- `/services` (Practice Areas): Overview of consulting practices.
  - `/services/custom-software-development`: Custom systems engineering.
  - `/services/web-development`: Scalable enterprise web portals.
  - `/services/mobile-app-development`: Native and cross-platform apps.
  - `/services/ai-intelligent-systems`: Machine learning, predictive models, NLP.
  - `/services/erp-solutions`: Odoo and custom ERP automation.
  - `/services/e-commerce-solutions`: Scalable transaction engines.
  - `/services/data-center-development`: Hybrid cloud infrastructure.
  - `/services/it-consultancy`: Enterprise architecture and strategy advisory.
- `/products` (Proprietary Platforms): Redirects to Orion.
  - `/products/smart-orion`: ERP, Point of Sale, and inventory sync systems.
  - `/products/smart-grc`: AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance management.
  - `/products/smart-crypto-exchange`: Institutional-grade cryptocurrency trading engines.
- `/industries` (Sectors Served): tailors compliance controls for Banking, Healthcare, Retail, Logistics, Manufacturing, Government.
- `/resources` (Advisory Assets): Whitepapers (offline ERP, GRC guides) and company profile.
- `/case-studies` (Client Proof): Portfolio overview (Coming Soon).
- `/about` (Firm History): Milestones, core values, engineering pillars.
- `/contact` (Lead intake): Discovery briefs intake form and HQ coordinate contacts.
- `/development-process` (Delivery flow): SDLC phases.
- `/engagement-models` (Commercial tracks): Procurement models (Dedicated team, fixed scope, hourly).
- `/technologies` (Stack mapping): Systems stack (React, Node, Spring Boot, Python AI, K8s, Docker).

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js App Router (16.2.9), React (19.2.4), Framer Motion animations.
- **Backend Stack**: Java Spring Boot (banking persistence), Node.js (high-concurrency gateways), Python (ML models).
- **Hosting / Infra**: Docker containerization, Kubernetes clusters, hybrid-cloud failover.
